project.title: Label free quantitative proteomics analysis based on LC-MS in Caki-1 to reveal the pathways associated with ERRα in ccRCC
project.projectDescription: To investigate the regulatory role of orphan nuclear receptor ERRα in the progression of ccRCC, we conducted the stable knockdown of ERRα in Caki-1 with shRNA lentivirus. The total protein samples of Caki-1 with shCtrl and shERRα were collected and subjected to label free quantitative proteomics analysis based on LC-MS, the differentially expressed proteins were selected based on the p value and fold-changes between two groups. Then, bioinformatics analysis was performed to reveal the pathways and key factors related to ERRα in ccRCC
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Caki-1 stably expressing with shCtrl or shERRα were collected with lysis buffer containing cooktail inhibitor (Applygen, P1265), and then centrifuged at 12,000rpm at 4°C for 15 minutes. The supernatant was collected and the protein concentration of the sample was determined using a BCA protein determination kit (Takara, T9300A). Then added 35µg of protein in digest solution (6M urea, 100mM TEAB) to total 100 µl, added 10µL of 100 mM IAA solution and incubate for 15 min in the dark at room temperature. After that, added 5% (w/w) Tripsin/Lys-C (Wako Chemicals, Osaka, Japan) to each sample and be incubated overnight at 37°C. Then samples were diluted by a factor of 1:1 with trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) in acetonitrile (ACN) and MilliQ water (1/5/94, v/v). 20µg of digested protein were thoroughly dried with a vacuum centrifuge after desalting it with C18 Stage-tips with EmporeDisksC18 from Varian (Palo Alto, CA, USA). A QExactive plus Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) outfitted with a nano electrospray ion source was used for all studies. A measured mass spectrum with a resolution of 70,000 and a continuous high collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation spectrum of the ten most common ions were obtained when the mass spectrometer was run in positive ion mode. Peptides were found using the full MS/dd MS2 (Top10) model, with a scan range of 400–1700 m/z.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MaxQuant (version 2.0.0.1) was used to process the raw data after being processed by Xcalibur software. The forward database was the UniProtKB database release (April 2021). The label-free quantification was carried out with the option of run to run matching. The relative protein abundance were analyzed based on p value and Foldchange (shERRα/shCtrl), and the protein expression with p＜0.05, FC ＞1.5 or ＜0.75 were marked as differently expressed proteins (DEPs).
